code:
Contractor Offboarding

contractor table:
  end_date
  contractor_type  (IT / non-IT)
  manager
  active

When end_date arrives:
  1. Revoke system access
  2. Manager confirms equipment returned
  3. IT gets a task to disable the account
caption: Three real outcomes, none of them automatic today.

caption: A deadline isn't an event — it needs a query, not a record change.
